thread:
hana: Noticed a few compatibility drifts between the Dedicated provisioning quickstart and the runtime that could confuse customers. Opening a small coordination thread to triage.

mike_docs: Link to the PR?

hana: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5321. Quick summary: YAML and Terraform examples still show camelCase keys; autoscale section references `cooldown` object path; SDK snippets show `provision_capacity`. Also the CLI example uses `--provision` flag.

lee: I'll take the YAML + TF changes. Proposed canonical YAML for the quickstart to paste in (keeps it minimal):

```yaml
reserved_pool: "team-analytics-pool"
autoscale:
  policy: "concurrency"
  threshold: 0.6
  cooldown_seconds: 210
  allow_burst: true
labels:
  preemptible: "false"
```

lee: Notes: use snake_case everywhere (`reserved_pool`, `cooldown_seconds`, `allow_burst`) and keep labels as strings to avoid YAML parsing surprises.

amelia: I'll update the SDK snippets (Python + TS). New method names are `create_capacity` and the helper is `wait_for_capacity_ready()` in both SDKs. Also will add a one-line comment about the async waiter.

mike_docs: Good call. Also we should add a tiny "Migration notes" callout at the top of the quickstart: bullet list with exact old->new mappings so infra scripts can be patched easily. Example: `reservedPool -> reserved_pool`, `provision_capacity -> create_capacity`, `--provision -> create-capacity`.

hana: Can docs-bot regenerate the snippets after amelia pushes?

docs-bot: snippet-gen: queued regeneration for `dedicated_capacity` examples at commit 3f4b2. Python, TypeScript, YAML, Terraform snippets will be available at internal/snippets/5321 once CI completes.

legal-bot: Heads-up from Legal: the quickstart currently suggests "99.9% availability for tenant pools" which is problematic. Please change to a soft phrasing and add a footnote linking to the SLA matrix that clarifies measurement is per reserved-pool-shard. Draft footnote text: "SLA values are reported per reserved-pool-shard. Aggregate availability across multi-shard pools may differ; see SLA matrix for details."

lee: I'll add the footnote and link. Also proposing an inline example showing `preemptible: "true"` for cost-optimized workloads and a one-line tradeoff: "preemptible pools may be evicted under contention."

amelia: For the autoscale section I'd like to include a short behavioral example instead of a full table. Something like:

"During cooldown_seconds (e.g., 210s), the autoscaler will not perform additional scale-ups even if the threshold is exceeded. Burst_allowed=true permits temporary overcommit for short spikes, but does not bypass cooldown windows."

mike_docs: That reads concise. Keep the quickstart focused on a single source of truth and link to a separate deep-dive doc for orchestration semantics / scale policy matrices.

hana: Plan: lee -> YAML/TF + SLA footnote + preemptible example; amelia -> SDK snippet rename + waiter comment; mike_docs -> migration callout + prose pass; docs-bot -> snippet regen link. I'll bundle into a single PR update on the same branch and ping reviewers. Target: merge by COB tomorrow.

amelia: Pushed SDK updates to branch `docs/dedicated-compat-sweep`. Will drop snippet-gen link in PR body once regenerated.

docs-bot: snippet-gen: regenerated examples for `dedicated_capacity` at commit 3f4b2. Preview: https://internal/snippets/5321 (internal).

mike_docs: Draft migration bullets dropped in PR description. Wording suggestion: use "tenant unit" instead of just "tenant" for the migration note to reduce ambiguity for multi-tenant deployments.

legal-bot: Agrees with that wording tweak.

hana: Thanks all. Quick reviewers: if you can give a thumbsup in the PR comments once the snippets link is live I'll merge after a final minor spellcheck. Aim to keep the quickstart tiny and accurate. :rocket:
